description: Deep Proof-Architecture & Verification Corpus for the November 2026 Alpoge-Claude RH/GRH Proof: human-readable LaTeX reconstructions, Lean/nanoda kernel audits, finite-field Stepanov, local/global GGP theta correspondence, and analytic/algorithmic consequences.

documents.title: Remark on the Formalized Proofs of the Riemann Hypothesis and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
documents.summary: Alpöge's 4-page Nov 20, 2026 announcement and 20-point chronological map: Stepanov determinant, CM curve invariant derivation divisibility, qN=Mk+R quadric, Guinand-Weil sign trick, sqrt(X)-length iterated unitary theta lifts U(X_0)->...->U(X_m), Chowla-Selberg/Siegel mass, Bessel/GGP periods, Rallis seesaw, sixfold cover of GL_5, Bost slope inequality, Vandiver weakening, Behrend Iwasawa tower, ERH pending.

documents.title: The Alpöge–Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis explained for the Riemann zeta function (v2, 265p)
documents.authors: Michael Rubinstein (aided by Claude, Codex, Gemini)
documents.summary: 265-page classical-ANT reconstruction (v2, Nov 22, 2026): derives RH from Main Inequality (M) and Dirichlet character estimates; reduces (M) to 13 numbered hypotheses; works the lemniscate Gaussian-lattice case in full; provides an Alpöge-remark dictionary and complete census of external theorems used in the Lean codebase.

documents.title: Independent Waterloo Verification of the Alpöge–Claude Lean 4 RH/GRH Release
documents.summary: Verification log covering exact SHA-256 of lean.tar.gz (239.3MB), Lean v4.33.1 + Mathlib 0df444a3, static scan for axioms/sorry/native_decide, exact 5 theorem statements (RH + GRH forms), #print axioms (only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), 175,187-module kernel replay, and Rust nanoda check of 1,484,729 declarations.

documents.title: End-to-End Proof Dependency Map & External Theorems Audit of the Alpöge–Claude Proof
documents.summary: Organizes the formalization into 10 reconstructed stages (Stages 1-10: analytic criterion, explicit formula, arithmetic Stepanov, theta-lift divisibility, p-adic gain/Hecke loss, LinkDIV period map, Bost slope/covolume, automorphic/Galois lifting, host field records, positive prime sum) plus catalog of internal packages PC-1..PC-7 and external theorems R1-R5.

documents.title: An End-to-End Mathematical Reconstruction of the Alpöge–Claude Route to the Riemann Hypothesis
documents.summary: Full LaTeX mathematical companion detailing one-sided window theorems, zeros against poles, sampled prime-power sums, numerical experiments, and the bridge from classical explicit formulas to the arithmetic Stepanov and theta-lift machinery.

documents.title: The Announced Proof of the Riemann Hypothesis: Route Guide & Community Verification Dashboard
documents.summary: Synthesis of independent verifications (Sutherland, Arledge, DeDeo, Rubinstein), theorem formalization caveats, and a 4-step proof roadmap covering reflection, prime statistics, localized Landau theorem, and slope inequality for iterated theta lifts.

documents.title: The Riemann Hypothesis for Function Fields over a Finite Field (Stepanov-Bombieri Method)
documents.summary: Reference exposition of Stepanov's elementary method and Bombieri's simplification over F_q, illustrating how Hasse-Schmidt hyperderivatives force high-order zero multiplicity — the exact obstruction Alpöge and Claude replaced over Z via iterated theta lifts.

documents.title: The Gross–Prasad Conjecture and Local Theta Correspondence
documents.summary: Foundational Annals/arXiv memoir connecting local unitary/symplectic Gan-Gross-Prasad conjectures for Bessel and Fourier-Jacobi periods directly to the theta correspondence and seesaw dual pairs.

documents.title: The Riemann Hypothesis: Past, Present and a Letter Through Time
documents.summary: Feb 2026 monograph contrasting spectral/noncommutative Weil-form extremization with Alpöge-Claude's arithmetical Stepanov/theta-lift proof.

documents.title: Conditional bounds for the least quadratic non-residue and related problems
documents.authors: Youness Lamzouri, Xiannan Li, Kannan Soundararajan
documents.summary: Now-unconditional explicit computable GRH bounds on least quadratic non-residues n_p < (ln p)^2, primes in APs, and L(1, chi).

documents.title: Beyond the Riemann Hypothesis bounds: A pair-correlation approach to the least prime in AP and smallest non-residue
documents.authors: Neelam Kandhil, Alessandro Languasco, Pieter Moree
documents.summary: Shows what remains conditional even AFTER GRH falls: vertical pair-correlation conjectures on L-function zeros still strictly sharpen horizontal GRH bounds.

documents.title: Landau–Siegel zeros over a base field and effective Brauer–Siegel
documents.summary: Quantifies Landau-Siegel lower bounds over general base fields k vs Dedekind/Artin ERH boundaries that Alpöge's Lean formalization has not yet proved.

documents.title: Breaking the 4 barrier for the bound of a generating set of the class group
documents.summary: Turns unconditional GRH into sub-(4 log^2 Delta) ideal class group generator bounds improving Buchmann's algorithm (vs ERH requirements for non-abelian fields).
